posts.title: Jujutsu Version Control: Show Bookmark Changes
posts.description: To see a list of the changes that are part of a bookmark’s change, run the jj log command with the following options: The -r flag The ancestors function, supplying the name of the bookmark in parentheses The following command shows the changes for a bookmark named trunk : jj log -r ancestors(trunk)

posts.title: Jujutsu Version Control: Using Github
posts.description: When working with version control you usually have your project in a remote repository using a service like GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket. This article shows how to put your Jujutsu repo on GitHub and push changes to GitHub. Most of the material in this article also applies to services like GitLab and Bitbucket.
